audited_surfaces.implication: Generated a phase-scoped index and selected family-named tools before x1 freeze.
Use compact official or primary source labels and preserve current, stable, draft, and watch classes.
Keep active phase, x1 and x2 state, standby lanes, open gates, and sanitized publication fields explicit.
A watcher, elapsed time, prepared message, or local pass is not completion; close only on the full checklist and equality proof.
Live v642-v6 solo routing and no-delegation instructions override older app-lane, cadence, and automatic CLI-update directions.
JSON, tests, diff, privacy, exact staged paths, push, and remote equality remain mandatory; shared omega-mini mutation is outside authority.

decision: A new reusable evidence-integrity runner set is justified by the ten new trace, evidence-class, authority-substitution, and step-ablation surfaces. No shared skill edit or semantic-free churn is justified.
